items.name: Rovigo Open 2018
items.information:
* You need to pay in advance the registration fee in order to complete your registration. No registrations will be accepted without payouts.
*  Remember to check you email address for confirmation message which will be likely sent 1-2 weeks before the competition.
* **You can have a full refund if you delete your registration by January 28th**, otherwise no refunds will be given.

![Image description](http://i.imgur.com/yztC4Jt.png) [Clicca qui per il sito web in italiano](https://cubingitaly.org/rovigo-18)

items.name: Penn Cube Day Winter 2018

venue.name: [University of Pennsylvania, Houston Hall](https://www.upenn.edu)
venue.details: Bodek Lounge, first floor of Houston Hall

items.information: Registration fee is $20. There will be no waitlist. If you want to be on the competitor list, sign up and pay as soon as possible! Refunds will be granted until 7pm on January 28th. Spectators free.
